status.main_product: Working capital marketplace and dynamic discounting platform
status.scope_reason: The company builds and operates an on-demand working capital digital marketplace providing supply-chain and receivables finance solutions.
status.evidence: C2FO operates a global working capital exchange platform that automates early payment dynamic discounting and supplier finance programs as stated by its official corporate materials.

claims.claim: The company reports its on-demand working capital exchange platform serves over 1.75 million in-network businesses globally, facilitating transaction capabilities across 14 languages and 48 currencies.
C2FO operates a proprietary web platform focusing on domestic on-demand working capital, early payment programs, and dynamic discounting matching buyers and suppliers directly.

The company's subsidiary, C2FO Factoring Solutions Private Ltd, connected its local C2treds platform to India's national Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) following regulatory approval in April 2024.
claims.corrected: The company's subsidiary, C2FO Factoring Solutions Private Ltd, connected its local C2treds platform to India's national Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) following regulatory approval in March 2024.

claims.claim: The company reports that its cloud-based working capital platform matches daily accounts payable and accounts receivable in seconds, processing over 40 million daily invoices and matching more than $110 billion of daily transactional volume.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its cloud-based working capital platform matches daily accounts payable and accounts receivable in seconds, processing over 50 million daily invoices and matching more than $110 billion of daily transactional volume.

claims.claim: The company reports that its system architecture supports automated integration options via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) API integrations, alongside non-API file transfers using its QuickConnect application or standard baseline codes.

The company announced a strategic partnership with Vic.ai in August 2022 to deliver an AI-driven invoice acceleration solution that automates invoice processing and integrates accelerated payments to improve the invoice-to-cash cycle.

The company reports serving major corporate enterprise buyers on its working capital platform, including Costco, REI, ThermoFisher, Philips, Walgreens, Mondelez, Macy's, Sysco, Home Depot, Ulta, Nordstrom, Giant Eagle, and HPE.

The company launched its TReDS platform in India with State Bank of India and Dabur India as the first participants, and later entered into agreements with Central Bank of India and Union Bank of India.
The company reports that it surpassed $500 billion in cumulative working capital funding globally as of March 2026.
The company reports that it delivered a record-breaking $78 billion in funding to businesses worldwide in 2022, marking a 42% increase over its 2021 performance.
The company reports operating a global platform serving customers across 160 to 180 countries, providing user support in up to 30 languages and offering early payment options in 43 to 60 currencies.
claims.corrected: The company reports operating a global platform serving customers across more than 160 countries, providing user support in 14 languages and offering early payment options in 43 currencies.

claims.claim: The company reports the completion of a $30 million funding round in April 2025 led by the International Finance Corporation, a member of the World Bank Group, alongside existing shareholders to accelerate platform expansion in emerging markets.
The company completed a $140 million fundraising round in February 2022 led by Third Point Ventures, with participation from Vista Credit Partners and Mubadala Capital.
The company reports it has surpassed $500 billion in cumulative working capital funding globally, serving over 1 million businesses across more than 180 countries and territories.
The company reports that its platform has facilitated early payments for the supply chains of over 200 global enterprise clients, including 96 of the Fortune 100 companies.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its platform has facilitated early payments for the supply chains of over 200 global enterprise clients, including 25 of the Fortune 100 companies.
